description: This line plot, titled "BBQ," illustrates the accuracy of four different activation functions—Squared Exponential, Tanh, ELU, and LLAMA-2-chat-7B—as a function of the number of demonstrations. The x-axis, labeled "#Demonstrations," is plotted on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1500, with tick marks at intervals of 250. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy," is also on a linear scale, ranging from 45 to 55. The "Squared Exponential" function is represented by a solid black line with circular markers, starting at an accuracy of approximately 53.5 and rising to about 56.5. The "Tanh" function is shown as a solid blue line with circular markers, beginning at around 50.5 and increasing to approximately 54.5. The "ELU" function is depicted with a solid purple line and circular markers, starting at about 48.5 and ending at roughly 53.5. The "LLAMA-2-chat-7B" function is represented by a dashed pink line with circular markers, beginning at approximately 47.5 and rising to about 52.5. All lines show a general upward trend as the number of demonstrations increases, with the "Squared Exponential" function consistently achieving the highest accuracy and the "LLAMA-2-chat-7B" function achieving the lowest.
